params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $relay=Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; $origin=(git -C $relay remote get-url origin).Trim(); $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('hcp-proc-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); git clone --quiet --branch agent/hcp-processes-20260929-0804 --single-branch $origin $tmp; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; try { $sha=(git -C $tmp rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); Set-Location $tmp; python -m unittest discover .\plugins\heaven-control-plane\tests -p 'test_processes.py' -v; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; python -m py_compile .\plugins\heaven-control-plane\heaven_control_plane\processes.py; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git diff --check; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output ('VERIFIED_PROCESSES_SHA='+$sha) } finally { Set-Location $HOME; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
